# Request for Proposals: St. Jude Hospital Expansion

## 1. Scope
Construction of a new 5-storey maternity wing and renovation of the existing emergency department.

## 2. Mandatory Technical Requirements
- H1: Hospital construction experience (at least 3 similar projects).
- H2: ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certifications.
- H3: Detailed bio-medical equipment integration plan.

## 3. Contact
- Submissions to: tenders@stjudehospital.org
- Deadline: 2026-10-01
